question: In 2025, Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Jayanti, also celebrated as Parakram Diwas, falls on which date?
solution:
The correct answer is __**23 January**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Jayanti**, celebrated as **Parakram Diwas** (Day of Valor), is observed every year on **23 January** to honor the birth anniversary of one of India’s most prominent freedom fighters.
 
• In **2025**, India will celebrate the **128th birth anniversary** of Netaji, reflecting on his indomitable spirit and contribution to the **country’s** struggle for independence.
 
• The **Government of India** officially designated **23 January** as **Parakram Diwas** in **2021** to inspire the youth of the nation to act with fortitude in the face of adversity.
 
• Subhas Chandra Bose was born on **23 January 1897** in **Cuttack**, **Odisha**, which was then a part of the Bengal Presidency</stron
